notes:
The package covers the card's confirmed components.pyCCT.pyCCT:SpectrometerWrapper entry symbol, not the Zaber rotary and linear stage classes in the same clone. A Driver has one native class, and the motion catalogue classes cannot bind an instrument.spectrometer resource; no stage motion, homing or stage limit is claimed. The card's PythonObjectDriver helper is not used: a direct Driver over SpectrometerWrapper expresses the typed settings and the explicit native shutter e-stop. NOT COVERED: the full detector-resolution spectrum. The fake returns 64 points as test data because the clone does not state the detector pixel count; the action filters those samples to the requested wavelength range. All numeric settings and both wavelength inputs are Limit.operator_required because no line of the clone states a numeric range; site-limits.example.json contains only illustrative operator bounds and is not a statement about a real unit. The fake backend is an in-memory stand-in, no hardware backend was run, and the package is unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null). No extension capability ids were used.
